segments.name: Influencer marketing
segments.description: Delivers creator economy solutions for brands through managed services and proprietary technology platforms, for enterprise brands, agencies and creators.
segments.evidence: IZEA is a technology-enabled influencer marketing company that delivers creator economy solutions for brands through managed services supported by proprietary technology that facilitates engagement and collaboration with social influencers and content creators.

revenueModel.text: Marketers such as brands, agencies or partners pay for managed influencer campaigns; limited SaaS access and transaction fees add a smaller share.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate revenue primarily from our Managed Services when a marketer (typically a brand, agency, or partner) pays us to provide custom content, influencer marketing, amplification, or other campaign management services ("Managed Services").

changes.text: The Company divested its Hoozu business unit in December 2024, ending its second reporting unit.
changes.evidence: On December 18, 2024, the Company completed the divestiture of Hoozu Holdings PTY Ltd. ("Hoozu") through its sale to a private Australian company.
